decisions.decision: L-Space moves from apps/lenticule-science-knowledge-vault to sites/l-space.561.group.
decisions.reason: It is the thing a domain names, not an application parameterized for a host. The estate already distinguishes apps/ (composed by something else) from sites/ (deployed at an address).
decisions.workerScriptNameReason: Retaining the script name moves the existing Worker and its D1 binding to the new hostname. Renaming would create a second Worker and orphan the first along with its learner state.

decisions.decision: The anonymous surface is an allowlist of routes over a separate asset tree, not a conditional over the whole corpus.
decisions.reason: L-Space compiles the entire live science forest with only path-segment filtering. A prefix rule or a per-request visibility check is how a public front door becomes a disclosure.
decisions.publicOptIn: visibility: public in a room's own frontmatter

buildEvidence.releaseReproducible: verified — two consecutive builds produced byte-identical index.json and the same release hash

localRuntimeVerification.method: wrangler dev --local, the real Worker against the real compiled release
localRuntimeVerification.defectFound: The front door answered `/` by requesting `/index.html`, which the static asset server canonicalises back to `/` - an infinite redirect loop. Every unit test passed through it because they mock the asset server. Fixed by passing the path through unchanged; the worker test's mock now canonicalises so the loop cannot return.
localRuntimeVerification.secondDefectFound: compatibility_date had been raised to 2026-08-27, past the installed workerd's maximum of 2026-08-18, which prevented the Worker from starting locally at all. Lowered to 2026-08-18.

upstreamCapabilityConnected.priorState: computed on every build, projected nowhere
declared as a dependency; only recallProbability was imported, and lightcone was never imported at all
upstreamCapabilityConnected.nowServedAt: /js/srs.mjs and /js/lightcone.mjs, type-stripped from upstream at build time

upstreamCapabilityConnected.capability: deterministic release bytes and world validation
upstreamCapabilityConnected.nowServedAt: every written artifact; the world is validated before any file is written

upstreamCapabilityDeclined.reason: No built dist/ in-tree, requires a tsc build, carries three runtime dependencies, and its own test documents its seed colours failing WCAG AA in light mode. Deferred rather than adopted under time pressure.
Indexes HTML pages. The L-Space corpus is content-addressed JSON rooms, so the shapes do not meet. Client-side search over the compiled index is the fitting tool.

operatorActionsRequired: Create or repoint a Cloudflare Access application at l-space.561.group/* with the intended allow policy.
Confirm ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN and ACCESS_AUD in wrangler.template.jsonc match that application; the checked-in values are science.561.group's and hold only if the same application is repointed.
Exempt the anonymous routes from the Access policy, or Access will intercept them before the Worker runs and the public door will never open.
Remove the science.561.group DNS record and its Access application once l-space.561.group is verified.
deferredInterfaces: Typed semantic-neighborhood and multi-projection TUFTE explorer
Per-room capability and permission model beyond the binary public/authenticated opt-in
